s1.syndrome_frame: Recurrent episodes of hypertension with associated palpitations and diaphoresis, suggesting a catecholamine-excess state, with a history of adrenal mass and positive family history suggestive of a hereditary syndrome
salient_findings: Presence of a nodule in the left adrenal bed on Gallium 68-DOTATATE PET scan
Prostatic lesion with increased size over time
key_facts: Initial presentation at age 18 years in 1984
10-cm mass of the organ of Zukerkandl in 1984
Presentation with palpitations and diaphoresis in 2014
Positive Gallium 68-DOTATATE PET scan for a nodule in the left adrenal bed
Prostatic lesion increased in size from 1.9 cm in 2014 to 2.9 cm in 2021
Tumors positive for GATA3, tyrosine hydroxylase, chromogranin A, and synaptophysin on immunohistochemistry

shortlist.why_kept: SDHB gene variant and history of paraganglioma

shortlist.label: Pheochromocytoma
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated 24-hour urinary normetanephrine and history of adrenal mass

shortlist.label: Paraganglioma
shortlist.why_kept: Positive Gallium 68-DOTATATE PET scan and history of paraganglioma

shortlist.label: Familial paraganglioma
shortlist.why_kept: Family history suggestive of hereditary syndrome and SDHB gene variant

shortlist.label: Prostatic paraganglioma
shortlist.why_kept: Prostatic lesion with positive immunohistochemistry results for paraganglioma markers

raw.rationale: The patient has a SDHB gene variant (c.338G>A, p.C113Y) and a history of paraganglioma (10-cm mass of the organ of Zukerkandl in 1984) and subsequent development of a nodule in the left adrenal bed, which is consistent with a diagnosis of SDHB-related paraganglioma.

rejected.label: Pheochromocytoma
rejected.why: Undetectable metanephrine and normal urinary 3-methoxytyramine levels are not typical for pheochromocytoma

rejected.label: Paraganglioma
rejected.why: While the patient has a history of paraganglioma, the presence of a SDHB gene variant suggests a more specific diagnosis of SDHB-related paraganglioma

rejected.label: Familial paraganglioma
rejected.why: Limited access to family history makes it difficult to confirm a familial component

rejected.label: Prostatic paraganglioma
rejected.why: While the patient has a prostatic lesion, the primary diagnosis is more likely related to the SDHB gene variant and the history of paraganglioma
